integrity_context.reproducibility: two independent runs, identical logical_result_hash, identical anchor logical_rows_sha256 (REPRODUCIBILITY.json)

reading_conventions.bars_conversion: native-bar counts derived by dividing market_ms quantiles by the stratum bar duration (15s=15000ms ... 4h=14400000ms); conversions are the interpreter's arithmetic on committed values and are marked derived

sign_convention_note.text: Positive direction_adjusted_return_bps is read as movement in the zone's registered direction. Basis: (a) at the FORMATION anchor (E1A synthesis canonical observation) direction-adjusted medians are 18 negative / 1 zero / 2 positive of 21 cells while >99% of zones are reached within a median of 2 bars, i.e. price drifts toward/into zones, which is movement against the registered direction; (b) at both E1B anchors the medians are uniformly positive. These two facts are jointly consistent only under the in-zone-direction-positive convention. This convention is not re-derived from scanner code (prohibited); all continuation/reversion language below depends on it and is labeled INTERPRETATION.
sign_convention_note.serialization_note: Several bearish direction_adjusted_p50 cells are serialized as -0.0 (e.g. 15s FIRST_TOUCH h1/h3/h5, 30s FIRST_TOUCH h1/h3). These are sign-bit artifacts of exact-zero medians under sign flip (same artifact class already recorded in E1A synthesis); they are read as exactly zero, not negative.

reading_conventions.rounding: committed values quoted at 3-6 significant digits; full precision lives in E1B_RESULTS.json

executive_phenotype_summary.one_line: The FVG lifecycle body is extremely fast (median formation->touch 2 native bars and touch->fill 1 native bar at all seven strata; 34.2-40.4% of touched fills resolve on the same bar), a scale-growing minority of touched zones never fills in-window (touch->fill right-censor 0.21% at 15s to 10.19% at 4h), and post-anchor direction-adjusted medians flip to uniformly positive (21/21 cells at FIRST_TOUCH and 21/21 at FILL) versus the formation anchor's predominantly negative pattern (18/21), with magnitudes small relative to dispersion at fine strata and carried by the bullish direction.

key_points.text: Touch incidence (lawful first-touch zones / lawful formations) declines monotonically with native scale: 0.9946 (15s, 226,686/227,909), 0.9944 (30s, 99,305/99,866), 0.9938 (1m, 43,428/43,701), 0.9859 (5m, 7,039/7,140), 0.9745 (15m, 2,136/2,192), 0.9503 (1h, 497/523), 0.9401 (4h, 157/167). Touch->fill duration (touched fills only): p25=0 native bars and p50=1 native bar at every stratum; p75 4-9 bars; p95 66-226 bars; observed-event p99 175-4,394 bars. Same-bar touch+fill is a substantial lifecycle mode at every stratum: 35.3% (15s, 79,865/226,210), 35.4% (30s, 35,055/99,011), 35.4% (1m, 15,286/43,227), 34.4% (5m, 2,397/6,961), 34.2% (15m, 716/2,094), 36.6% (1h, 175/478), 40.4% (4h, 57/141). Path: tables.strata.rows[tf].same_bar_touch_fill_n, .touch_to_fill_market_ms, .touched_fill_n.

Touched-but-unfilled (right-censored after touch) fraction rises with scale: 0.21% (15s), 0.30% (30s), 0.46% (1m), 1.11% (5m), 1.97% (15m), 3.82% (1h), 10.19% (4h). Path: tables.strata.rows[tf].touch_to_fill_right_censor_fraction.

Direction-adjusted prospective medians are positive in 21/21 stratum-horizon cells at FIRST_TOUCH and 21/21 at FILL, versus the FORMATION anchor's 18 negative / 1 zero / 2 positive of 21 (E1A synthesis). This is a descriptive sign-pattern flip across lifecycle stages, not a tested effect. Paths: tables.strata.rows[tf].first_touch/fill.horizons[h].direction_adjusted_return_bps.p50; E1A synthesis canonical_observations.

The positive post-touch/post-fill central tendency is weak relative to dispersion at fine strata (15s FIRST_TOUCH h1: median +0.014 bps against IQR [-0.818, +0.870] bps and p05-p95 [-3.22, +3.32] bps, n=226,686) and rests on small samples at coarse strata (4h FILL: n=141). It is also asymmetric by direction: bearish direction-adjusted medians are approximately zero or negative at most cells while bullish medians are positive and grow with horizon. 'Weak central tendency, not strong directional behavior' is the correct description.

Gap-through fills (first_touch_observed=false, never imputed) total 1,010: 682 (15s), 213 (30s), 81 (1m), 20 (5m), 10 (15m), 4 (1h), 0 (4h); 0.19-0.83% of per-stratum fill anchors. The committed FILL aggregates do not stratify prospective outcomes by first_touch_observed, and these counts are far too small for descriptive outcome comparison at 5m and coarser scales. Path: tables.strata.rows[tf].gap_through_fill_n; E1B_SCANNER_INTEGRITY_GATE.json gap_through_fill_n.

Development-derived median splits on gap_atr and fvg_quality produce no scale-consistent, horizon-stable descriptive gradient at either anchor; the largest split differences occur in the smallest strata (1h ~248/cell, 4h ~70-79/cell), consistent with small-sample noise. All split readings remain partition descriptions, not thresholds.

executive_phenotype_summary.verdict_context: All core phenotype questions (lifecycle timing, censoring, prospective response, splits, stage comparison) are answerable from the committed aggregates and are internally consistent across the integrity gate, the fill-touch audit, reproducibility, and the E1A/E1B formation counts. One mission sub-question (gap-through vs touched-fill post-fill behavior) is not assessable from the committed evidence and is registered as a limitation plus a later-testable question rather than as a scanner defect; hence PASS_TO_SYNTHESIS rather than REWORK_REQUIRED.

cross_stratum_descriptive_comparison.text: Descriptive only (no pooling, no cross-scale identity): (1) the touch->fill body shape in native-bar units is scale-invariant through the median (p25=0, p50=1 everywhere) while the tail in native bars narrows with scale (p95 204/188/181/209/226/152/66 bars for 15s..4h); in wall-clock terms p95 rises from ~51 minutes (15s) to ~11 days (4h). (2) Touch incidence and post-touch censoring both degrade monotonically with scale. (3) Direction-adjusted medians grow with scale and horizon, but so does dispersion and so does small-N exposure; horizons are native-bar-relative, so cross-stratum magnitude comparison conflates horizon wall-clock length and is not an exposure-matched comparison.

formation_vs_touch_vs_fill_comparison.basis: FORMATION anchor figures from the frozen E1A synthesis (canonical_observations) against E1B FIRST_TOUCH/FILL aggregates. The E1A and E1B logical result hashes differ (1b701c01... vs 2a7a142c...) because the anchor stage differs; formation counts reconcile exactly (381,498 both).

observations.text: Direction-adjusted median sign pattern by stage: FORMATION 18 negative / 1 zero / 2 positive of 21 cells (E1A synthesis); FIRST_TOUCH 21/21 positive; FILL 21/21 positive. The descriptive directional behavior changes sign class after contact.

Stage conditioning changes the descriptive picture materially: at formation the central tendency is movement against the zone's registered direction (drift toward/into the zone, which is why zones touch and fill with median 2 and 1-8 bars); after touch and after fill the central tendency is movement back in the registered direction. The formation-stage apparent tendency is therefore REVERSED, not merely weakened, at the later anchors - subject to the sign-convention note and to the caveat that anchor populations are selected (touched/filled zones) and horizon clocks differ (formation-anchored windows start earlier in zone life).

Magnitude grows monotonically along the lifecycle at most cells: e.g. 1m direction-adjusted h5 median +0.074 (FT) -> +0.266 (FILL); 15m +1.082 (FT) -> +1.607 (FILL); 4h +13.267 (FT) -> +15.723 (FILL). FILL medians exceed FIRST_TOUCH medians in 19/21 cells (exceptions: 1h h3, 4h h1). This is descriptive sharpening with stage progression, not incremental predictive value.

Dispersion grows with stage too (FILL h1 IQRs are wider than FIRST_TOUCH h1 IQRs at fine strata, e.g. 15s [-0.839, +0.910] vs [-0.818, +0.870] bps; 5m [-4.52, +4.89] vs [-4.23, +4.42]); so the stage-wise median growth is not matched by a proportionate tightening. Stage conditioning re-centers the distribution; it does not visibly concentrate it in the committed quantiles.

Lifecycle timing reconciles across stages: formation->fill p50 in native bars is 7/7/7/7/8/8/5 (15s..4h) in E1B, matching the E1A formation-stage figure exactly, and formation->touch p50 is 2 bars at every stratum in both.

is_stage_conditioning_more_informative.text: Descriptively yes: the sign-class flip (formation-negative to touch/fill-positive) and the direction-asymmetry structure (bullish-positive, bearish-zero-to-negative) are only visible once the lifecycle stage is conditioned on; the formation anchor alone mixes pre-contact drift with post-contact response. This is a statement about descriptive resolution, explicitly NOT a claim of incremental predictive value - no test, no null, no out-of-sample anything.

gap_through_analysis.definition: Fills with first_touch_observed=false: the filling bar crossed the far edge without a recorded overlap touch. Never imputed as touch; excluded from the FIRST_TOUCH cohort (contract gap_through_rule; E1A resolved anomaly A1 = expected producer semantics).

observations.text: Absolute counts concentrate at fine strata (682 of 1,010 at 15s); relative share of fills rises with scale to 0.83% at 1h and is exactly 0 at 4h (n=141 fills).

The committed FILL prospective tables do not split outcomes by first_touch_observed; the direction/gap_atr/fvg_quality splits pool both populations. No gap-through-specific post-fill behavior is observable in this evidence base.

Adequacy verdict for descriptive comparison: NOT SUPPORTED at any stratum. Even at 15s (n=682) no per-population outcomes are committed; at 5m/15m/1h the counts (20/10/4) are an order of magnitude below any defensible descriptive sample; at 4h the population is empty. Aggregate FILL statistics therefore carry a 0.19-0.83% gap-through mixture whose influence on committed quantiles is expected to be negligible but is unverified.

Does gap-through fill have different post-fill behavior from ordinary touch->fill? Registered; requires a per-population outcome split in a future measurement contract; not testable from committed aggregates and not tested here.

formation_to_touch_derived_ceiling.note: derived: never-touched fraction = 1 - touch_incidence caps identifiable formation->touch quantiles

observed_event_quantiles_vs_unconditiona.text: Touch->fill unconditional p99 is identifiable ONLY at 15s/30s/1m (ceilings 0.9979/0.9970/0.9954). At 5m/15m/1h/4h the committed p99 values (2,388/1,648/699/175 native bars) are observed-event (filled-zone) quantiles, NOT unconditional population quantiles: 1.1%/2.0%/3.8%/10.2% of touched zones never filled in-window.
Formation->fill unconditional p99 is identifiable only at 15s/30s/1m (ceilings 0.9955/0.9936/0.9910).

Observed-event maxima for touch->fill: 682,739 native bars at 15s (~118.5 days), 341,358 at 30s, 170,679 at 1m, 34,135 at 5m, 11,257 at 15m, 2,831 at 1h, 459 at 4h (~76.5 days). Max/p99 ratios are extreme (e.g. 15s: 682,739/3,885 ~ 176x).

challenge_of_the_phenotype_label.text: 'Rapid body + long tail' SURVIVES as the touch->fill phenotype at fine/mid strata and for the body at all strata: p25=0 and p50=1 native bar everywhere (34-40% same-bar), p75 4-9 bars, p95 66-226 bars, observed-event p99 175-4,394 bars at fine strata. The required refinement is: (1) at 5m-4h the 'long tail' is administratively truncated - the unconditional upper tail beyond p98.9/p98.0/p96.2/p89.8 (5m/15m/1h/4h) is unidentifiable, so the true unconditional p99 is not observed anywhere coarser than 1m and must not be quoted as if it were; (2) 'long' should be quantified in native bars per stratum, since wall-clock tail length scales with bar size (p95 from ~51 minutes at 15s to ~11 days at 4h); (3) the label describes duration-to-fill, not post-fill or post-touch response behavior, which is a separate phenotype dimension.

do_not_pretend: No unconditional p99 or max claim at 5m/15m/1h/4h for any duration variable.
No interpretation of right-censored lifetimes as completed fills; coarse-scale fill fractions are window-censored lower bounds (E1A must-not-claim, reaffirmed).

magnitude_vs_dispersion.text: Fine strata: medians are 0.2-3% of the p05-p95 span (15s FT h1: 0.014 vs 6.53 bps span; 1m FT h1: 0.065 vs 13.76 bps span) - weak central tendency.
Coarse strata: 4h FILL h3 median +18.16 bps against h1 IQR [-36.13, +41.03] and p05 -95.65, n=141 - proportionally larger but small-N.

Sign consistency across horizons within stratum: direction-adjusted medians positive at all three horizons in all seven strata at both anchors; raw medians negative in exactly one cell (4h FILL h1). Magnitude is non-monotone in horizon in several cells (30s FT h5 < h3; 5m FT h5 < h3; 5m FILL h5 < h3; 1h FILL h3 < h1; 4h FT h3 < h1).

direction_asymmetry.text: The pooled positive medians are asymmetrically composed: bullish direction-adjusted medians are positive and grow with horizon at every stratum (e.g. 15m FT: +0.63/+2.41/+2.93, n=1,231; 1h FILL: +3.77/+8.10/+15.41, n=279), while bearish medians are approximately zero or negative at most cells (15s FT: -0.0/-0.0/-0.0, n=111,069; 5m FILL: -0.02/-0.10/-0.97, n=3,214; 1h FILL h3/h5: -3.06/-4.89, n=203). Only 4h shows clearly positive bearish medians at FIRST_TOUCH (+4.5/+1.4/+7.7, n=63). Sign consistency across directions is therefore NOT established; the phenotype's positive lean is a bullish-side descriptive structure.

post_fill_characterization.text: Under the in-zone-direction-positive convention, post-fill direction-adjusted medians positive and growing with horizon are most consistent with movement in the zone's registered direction after structural fill - i.e. continuation of the gap-direction leg, equivalently reversion of the filling move (the two labels describe the same committed quantity from different reference frames). Neutralization (near-zero post-fill center) fits the fine-stratum magnitudes only in the sense that all fine-stratum medians are near zero relative to dispersion; it does not fit the coarse strata. 'No clear central tendency' would overstate the null case given 21/21 sign consistency at both anchors, but 'strong directional behavior' would overstate 0.014-bps medians against 6.5-bps spans. The defensible description: sign-consistent, magnitude-weak, bullish-carried in-zone-direction lean after touch and after fill, strengthening with horizon and with native scale.

prospective_response_assessment.not_claimed: None of the above is a trading claim; 'continuation'/'reversion' are descriptive leanings under a derived sign convention, not strategy statements, and no significance test has been run anywhere in E1B.

development_derived_split_assessment.status: gap_atr and fvg_quality median splits are DEVELOPMENT-derived descriptive partitions. They are NOT pre-registered thresholds, NOT decision thresholds, NOT confirmed cutoffs, NOT strategy rules.

findings.text: FIRST_TOUCH gap_atr split: low>high at 1m (all horizons) and 4h (all horizons); high>low at 1h (all horizons); mixed at 15s, 30s, 5m, 15m. No cross-stratum consistency.

FIRST_TOUCH fvg_quality split: low>high at 1m and 15m (all horizons); high>low at 30s h1 and 5m h1; mixed elsewhere; sign flips across horizons within strata (4h: h1 low>high, h3 high>low, h5 low>high).
FILL gap_atr split: high>low at 15s h3/h5, 30s, 1m, 5m (all horizons); mixed at 15m/1h; low>high at 4h h1/h3. Consistency is partial and scale-dependent.
FILL fvg_quality split: high>low at 15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 1h (all horizons); mixed at 15m and 4h (4h h1: low +12.74 vs high -4.76, n=71/70).

Overall: no development partition exhibits a stable, scale-consistent descriptive gradient; where orderings are locally stable (1m/5m FILL, 1h FILL fvg_quality) the cells are exactly the mid-size strata, and the largest separations occur in the smallest cells (1h ~241-249, 4h ~70-79 per cell), the regime where median-split differences are least trustworthy. The splits generate hypotheses (e.g. 'fvg_quality modifies post-fill response'), not findings.
Does FVG quality modify touch->fill duration and/or post-fill response after controlling for native scale? Registered only.

anomalies_or_suspicious_patterns.text: Negative-zero serialization: bearish direction_adjusted_p50 = -0.0 in multiple cells (15s FIRST_TOUCH h1/h3/h5; 30s FIRST_TOUCH h1/h3; 15s FILL h1; 30s FILL h1 = -2.1e-12). Same sign-bit artifact class already recorded in the E1A synthesis. Read as exact zero; recommend canonicalizing -0.0 to 0.0 in future artifacts.

Raw vs direction-adjusted sign divergence at 4h FILL h1 (raw p50 -0.145 vs direction-adjusted p50 +8.309 bps, n=141) and magnitude divergence at 4h FIRST_TOUCH h5 (raw +1.106 vs direction-adjusted +13.267 bps, n=157). Expected under sign-pooling with unbalanced directions, but any future reader quoting 'raw' medians at coarse strata will get opposite-signed answers to the direction-adjusted ones.

Non-monotone maxima across horizons at fixed N (e.g. 15s FIRST_TOUCH raw_price_delta max 77.89 at h3 vs 65.37 at h5; both n=226,686, missing 0). Genuine property of differing window endpoints (the h3-extreme event declines by h5), not a data defect; flagged so monotonicity is not assumed in later reading.

Direction-split imbalance: bullish anchors outnumber bearish at every stratum (e.g. 15s FT 115,617 vs 111,069; 4h FT 94 vs 63; 4h FILL 84 vs 57). Consistent with the E1A bullish-share gradient; carries into every pooled median.

The contract lists first_touch_observed as permitted FILL conditioning and stratifies the fill cohort by it, but the committed prospective aggregates do not report the true/false outcome split; the gap-through post-fill question (mission FILL item 3) is therefore unanswerable from the evidence base. Not a scanner defect (the fill-touch audit shows perfect true/false payload agreement); a reporting-scope gap to register.

Repeated maxima near 1.024e10 ms for durations at 15s/30s/1m (~118.5 days) across formation->touch, touch->fill, and formation->fill: consistent with long-lived zones formed early in the window resolving late; not window-clipped (window length ~277.9 days) and consistent across strata.

Continuation/reversion/neutralization labels are descriptive leanings under a derived sign convention, not established behavior.
The stage comparison is not incremental predictive value.
Observed-event p99/max at 5m/15m/1h/4h are not unconditional population quantiles (administrative right censoring); no unconditional p99 beyond 1m.
Touch incidence, fill fractions, and censor fractions are window-censored accounting quantities, not lifetime probabilities or hazards.
Development median splits are not thresholds, cutoffs, or confirmed quality/gap effects.
1h/4h split separations and 4h bearish-positive medians are small-sample medians, not established effects.
Gap-through post-fill behavior was NOT characterized; no claim about gap-through zones' post-fill response.
Bearish -0.0 cells are sign-bit artifacts of exact-zero medians, not negative tendencies.
Horizons are native-bar-relative; no exposure-matched cross-stratum magnitude comparison.
Nothing here transfers to E2, E3, confirmation, or live use.
